description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities are not documented and available.
applicability: Applies when an organization does not have documented operating procedures for information processing facilities, or when procedures are not made available to personnel who need them, potentially leading to inconsistent operations and increased security risks.

metadata.detection_notes: Review operations documentation repositories, verify existence of documented procedures for critical systems, check procedure accessibility and version control, assess procedure completeness and accuracy, examine procedure review and update processes.
